    Profile

    Reimei is the last descendant of Shiba Senko, the most detested faction in Wadatsumi. He defeats his opponents through forbidden techniques regarded as foul and cowardly. In his loneliness due to being a hated individual, his secret enjoyment during his free time is to enjoy sweet bean desserts by himself.

    Origin: Wadatsumi
    Gender: Male
    Height: 186cm
    Weight: 79kg
    Birthday: Oct 9
    Blood Type: Type Kn
    Zodiac: Moon of the Fiery Imperial Skies
    Likes: Sweet bean desserts
    Hobbies: Watching traditional Wadatsumi dance
    Illust: ―
    CV: 松岡禎丞
